name: Dumbbell Kickstand Deadlift
steps: Stand in front of a low box holding dumbbells at your sides and rest one foot's toes lightly behind you on the box.
Keep most of your weight on the front foot with a soft knee as you hinge your hips back.
Lower the dumbbells close along your front shin with a flat spine, then drive through the front foot to stand.
Complete the working leg, then switch sides and repeat.
tips: Keep your hips level and the dumbbells close to your standing leg.
Use the rear foot only for light balance rather than pushing off the box.
